title: Make June's BACK option return immediately
body:
The Opus 5 reference playtest on published build b7dd890e (seed2026090504,85 accepted decisions) reported that June Pike's BACK option required a second BACK. The retained runner-enforced session is published in the playtest corpus.

Source inspection reproduces the mismatch: keep_cattle_terms says BACK/Return to Cade's reviews but goes to june_cattle_terms_confirmed, whose only topic is another BACK (return_to_cade). The first click should close June's review immediately so the player can talk to Cade.

Make this one navigation action. Preserve June's agreement, all existing plan-consent rules, the blocked north exit, and free dialogue navigation in journey accounting. Keep the same action identity and aliases. Update the existing gameplay, MCP/compact-view, browser-engine parity and save/reload expectations honestly, retaining their state and consent checks. Preserve legacy dialogue-node interpretation for saved states where needed. Add a bug trace, obtain independent review, run pre/post crawl and the full health bar, and verify the human UI before landing.

evidence.summary: Reference-tier Opus report and matching dialogue graph show the extra BACK screen.
